findings.request_and_URI_boundary: No material mismatch found in the reviewed create/list boundary. Create checks authentication, Origin and CSRF before key/body parsing; enforces one idempotency/content-type header, no POST query, identity-only content encoding, an inclusive streamed 8 MiB cap, duplicate-key/nonfinite rejection, UTF-8 parsing and 64-level nesting. It preserves escaped lone surrogates through ASCII-escaped semantic TEXT and requires scalar project_id. List parsing caps query bytes, rejects malformed percent/UTF-8, duplicate and unknown fields, enforces canonical positive limit 1..100/default25, and validates authenticated cursor bytes as specified by contract v2.
findings.authorization_and_replay: The create path closes preflight DB/session locks before awaiting the fixed snapshot bridge, then authenticates again in a fresh READ COMMITTED transaction. It checks the existing actor/route/key before project lock and again after guard-first plus membership FOR UPDATE NOWAIT; post-lock authorization time is sampled through auth.now(). A raced global idempotency winner is handled after full rollback in a fresh scoped replay probe. Replay rechecks session, original-project active membership and ownership before comparing digest; it does not require current profile files, catalog or eligibility. A bridge failure also receives one fresh authenticated replay probe before fixed error mapping. These paths align with the approved transaction advice at source level.
findings.acceptance_and_commit: The new-acceptance transaction compares all nine immutable catalog fields, checks enabled/complete/mode/current grant, validates available caller-owned same-project artifact IDs, and inserts only job, command with full ASCII semantic payload and digest, outbox, and RESERVED workspace intent. Hooks cover each insertion and pre/post-commit/response boundaries. commit_started is set only after the precommit hook immediately before transaction-context exit; precommit errors roll back and map to dependency failure, while commit/after-commit/response uncertainty maps to COMMIT_UNCERTAIN. Only the named commands actor/route/key unique constraint enters winner replay recovery. No product source creates workflow steps, filesystem effects, or artifact uploads.
findings.DTO_and_pagination: The code projects the specified Job keys from durable command/job rows, emits the initial-only Snapshot envelope with empty steps and last_event_id sentinel, and scopes job/command reads and list rows by active membership plus owner or live same-job read delegation. Cursor generation and verification use the v2 canonical serialization, exact version typing, constant-time MAC comparison, actor/route/scope binding, and descending composite boundary. Error mapping is fixed and avoids serializing exception text.
findings.operator_and_privileges: The operator CLI accepts only the two fixed subcommands and bounded stdin DTOs, uses explicit private settings/operator DSN, derives authority_id from current_user in SQL, and grants only in mock mode. It returns the contract's exact AUTHORITY_INVALID_REQUEST / AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN / AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE classes and exits 2/3/0 respectively. It rejects lone surrogates in project_id/evidence_ref and does not expose evidence_ref. Revoke unknown/cross-project handling is AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN. Existing migrations 001/002 remain byte-identical to their reviewed source pins; product additions use current schema and no migration was part of this review.
findings.remaining_test_questions: Source inspection cannot establish PostgreSQL lock timing, rollback/commit acknowledgment outcomes, FK/trigger behavior, or actual FastAPI response/log behavior. The independent TC suite must demonstrate both cross-project global-key races with distinct sessions, membership trigger inversion/NOWAIT rollback, expiry/revocation during capture/guard wait, exact row counts at each fault boundary, and restart/replay from persisted TEXT. This review makes no runtime or acceptance claim.

execution_status: Read-only inspection only. No tests, service, database, or network were run. This initial source review is not final G4 acceptance.
